title: Pre-registration: DOTA-val detector-vs-VLM counting
rationale: Non-circular, adequately-powered test of whether routing resolvable-M2 counting to an in-domain detector beats the VLM. DOTA-v1 val (458 imgs) is held out from the detector's DOTA-train training.

data.label_format: YOLO-OBB: class_idx x1 y1 x2 y2 x3 y3 x4 y4 (normalized)
data.image_sample: 200 random val images, seed=42 (bounds VLM compute; >=600 nonzero cells expected)

ground_truth.gt_strict: count = number of label rows of that class
ground_truth.gt_resolvable: count only instances whose OBB longer side >= 10 px (s=10) in actual pixels; ties to the paper's GSD<=d/s answerability floor

detector.note: conf=0.25 is the package/pilot default, chosen a priori; reported as primary regardless of which conf minimizes error

vlm_baseline.prompt: How many <class_noun> are in this image? Answer with a single integer only.
vlm_baseline.parse: first integer via \b(\d+)\b; parse-fail = error for exact-match, excluded from MAE (report fail rate)

statistics.CIs: cluster bootstrap by image, 10000 resamples, 95% CI for MAE diff and exact-acc diff

zero_instance_cells: kept; pred=0 correct; reported separately (false-positive test)
headline_claim_allowed: detector-vs-VLM PAIRED only (never headline detector-vs-GT, which shares DOTA convention); claim is conditional: 'where an in-domain detector exists for the class'
validity_gate: yolo11l-obb trained on DOTA train split (1411 imgs); val (458) held out -> non-circular
